name: Berggasthof Hinterduxerhof
beschreibung: The Berggasthof Hinterduxerhof is located near Kufstein in Tirol. The inn sits at an elevation and offers a view of the Inntal. The rooms are rustically furnished. The restaurant serves Tiroler and Austrian dishes. The inn is a popular base for hikers and skiers. The surrounding area invites outdoor activities. The house is run as a family business.
